cmd.description: Locks the current channel (prevents @everyone from sending messages).
cmd.duration: Unlock automatically after this time, e.g. 30m, 2h, 1d (up to 30 days)

lock.title: Channel locked
lock.done: {channel} is locked. Members can't send messages here until it's unlocked.
lock.failed: An unexpected error occurred while trying to lock the channel. Check my permissions (I need 'Manage Channels').
lock.badDuration: That duration isn't valid. Use for example 30m, 2h or 1d (from 1 minute to 30 days). Nothing was changed.
lock.doneUntil: {channel} is locked until {time} ({relative}). Members can't send messages here until then.
lock.dbDown: The database is not responding, so the channel was not locked. Nothing was changed.
lock.partial: Discord refused part of the lock, so I undid it. Check my permissions here (I need 'Manage Channels' and 'Manage Permissions').
lock.botMissing: I'm missing {perms} in {channel}, so I can't lock it. Nothing was changed.

rolesLocked.one: Also locked for {count} role that had its own Send Messages permission here: {roles}. /unlock gives it back.
rolesLocked.other: Also locked for {count} roles that had their own Send Messages permission here: {roles}. /unlock gives it back.

rolesKept.one: Not locked for {count} staff role (it keeps its own Send Messages permission here): {roles}.
rolesKept.other: Not locked for {count} staff roles (they keep their own Send Messages permission here): {roles}.

cmd.description: Unlocks the current channel (allows @everyone to send messages again).

unlock.notLocked: {channel} is not explicitly locked (everyone can already send messages).
unlock.title: Channel unlocked
unlock.done: {channel} is unlocked. Members can talk here again.
unlock.failed: An unexpected error occurred while trying to unlock the channel. Check my permissions (I need 'Manage Channels').
unlock.notOverwrite: {channel} is not locked by its own permissions: Send Messages is denied by its category or the @everyone role, so unlocking here would change nothing.
unlock.dbDown: The database is not responding, so the channel was not unlocked. Nothing was changed.
unlock.botMissing: I'm missing {perms} in {channel}, so I can't unlock it. Nothing was changed.
unlock.autoDone: {channel} was unlocked automatically: the lock time is over.

skipped.one: {count} permission was changed by someone since the lock, so I left it as it is.
skipped.other: {count} permissions were changed by someone since the lock, so I left them as they are.

unlock.partial: Discord refused part of the unlock ({done} of {total} permissions restored), so {channel} may still be partly locked. Check my permissions here (I need 'Manage Channels' and 'Manage Permissions'), then run /unlock again.

cmd.description: Delete a specific amount of messages

purge.range: Please specify a number between 1 and 100.
purge.title: Messages Purged
purge.failed: An unexpected error occurred during message deletion. Note: Messages older than 14 days cannot be bulk deleted.
purge.botMissing: I'm missing {perms} in {channel}, so I can't delete messages there. Nothing was deleted.
purge.empty: There are no messages to delete in {channel}.

allTooOld.one: {count} message is older than 14 days. Discord can't bulk-delete messages older than 14 days, so nothing was deleted.
allTooOld.other: All {count} messages are older than 14 days. Discord can't bulk-delete messages older than 14 days, so nothing was deleted.

preview.one: Delete {count} message from the last 14 days in {channel}?
preview.other: Delete {count} messages from the last 14 days in {channel}?

previewOld.one: {count} message is older than 14 days and will be skipped.
previewOld.other: {count} messages are older than 14 days and will be skipped.

purge.previewNote: Messages older than 14 days can't be bulk-deleted by Discord.
purge.previewExpires: This preview expires {time}. Nothing is deleted until you press Delete.
purge.expired: This preview expired. Run /purge again. Nothing was deleted.
purge.notYours: Only the moderator who ran /purge can use these buttons.

skippedOld.one: Skipped {count}: older than 14 days (Discord can't bulk-delete those).
skippedOld.other: Skipped {count}: older than 14 days (Discord can't bulk-delete those).

cmd.description: Post, update or preview the server rules message
cmd.post: Post the rules with the design saved on the dashboard
cmd.postChannel: Where to post them (default: the channel saved on the dashboard)
cmd.update: Change the posted rules message to the current rules and design
cmd.preview: Show the rules post only to you, without posting it

rules.mainOnly: The rules can only be posted from the main server.
rules.notLoaded: The saved settings are not loaded (database not responding). Nothing was changed.
rules.noChannel: No rules channel is saved. Pick one with the channel option, or save one on the dashboard Rules page.
rules.cannotSee: I cannot see that channel. Pick another one.
rules.channelGone: The saved rules channel no longer exists. Pick one with the channel option, or save another on the dashboard Rules page.
rules.saveFailed: Could not save the post (database not responding). {undone}
rules.postRefused: Discord refused the post. Nothing was posted.
rules.postUndone: The post was removed again. Nothing was changed.
rules.updateRefused: Discord refused the update. Some messages may already show the new rules. Try /rules update again.
rules.updateUndone: New extra messages were removed again and the saved post was not changed. Run /rules update again.
rules.notPosted: The rules have not been posted yet. Use /rules post first.
rules.earlierPost: The earlier post in <#{channelId}> stays where it is. Next time, use /rules update to change the post instead.
rules.updated: The posted rules in <#{channelId}> were updated ({messages}).
rules.previewHead: Preview of the rules post ({messages}, saved channel: {where}). Only you can see this. Nothing was posted.
